name: init
description: Explicit startup handshake before decisions, including after a restart.

name: free-check
description: Big blind can check when nobody raised; raise uses a street total.

name: cheap-call
description: First preflop actor can call one big blind.

name: expensive-call
description: The starter may fold; other legal strategies are equally valid.

name: raise-to
description: Raising to 50 adds 40, not 50, to the hero contribution.

name: short-call
description: to_call equals 12 here; every hand originally began with equal stacks.

name: call-below-wager
description: Unequal-stack compatibility case: hero owes 20 but has 12; the official event still resets equal stacks.

name: short-all-in-raise
description: Only an all-in raise to 35 is legal, not an arbitrary sub-minimum raise.

name: bet-not-reopened
description: Unequal-stack compatibility case: two short all-ins do not reopen the previous caller’s betting.

name: flop-open-bet
description: Prior-street chips do not count toward a new bet target.

name: turn-side-pots
description: Current contribution layers can include an unmatched top layer pending later settlement.

name: river-no-raise
description: There is no aggressive action against only all-in opponents.

name: hand-end-demo
description: The physical workshop demo settles to +50, -40, -10, 0.

name: hand-end-fold
description: A bot that folded still receives the public result and can update state.

name: uncontested-end
description: No runout or folded/private hands are revealed after an uncontested win.

name: hand-end-odd-chip-split
description: Two players tie on a royal-flush board; the first winner left of the button receives the odd chip.

name: hand-end-side-pots
description: Unequal-stack compatibility case: the strongest hand wins the main pot, another hand wins the side pot.
